k7.disputed_point: Size of the market reaction. The key says shares rose about 11.5%. Sources I opened put the jump at roughly 16–23%, about double the key's figure.
k7.why: The cited beancount.io page says nothing about the share reaction. When I fetched it, it contained no stock price, after-hours move or percentage change. The pre-earnings close was about $306 (implied $305.84). Several outlets reported a much bigger move after the Sept 2, 2026 results. Tikr's headline says shares jumped 23%. 247WallSt reported +23% to $377.11 intraday on Sept 3. Schaeffer's reported +20% on the morning of Sept 3. Goldesel.de reported +21.6% to $371.94. A Zacks/Finviz piece said about 16% on Sept 3. Investing.com and others reported about 22–23% after hours. Reported closing figures conflict. The closing gain was at least about 16% by the lowest report and about 22% by the highest. I found no source for 11.5%, and it matches none of these moves.
k7.corrected_answer: Shares jumped sharply after the results. They rose about 22–23% in after-hours trading on Sept 2, 2026, and were up roughly 20–23% intraday on Sept 3 from a prior close of about $306. Reported closing gains ranged from about 16% to about 22%, and the stock hit its highest level since late 2021. This figure comes from secondary sources.
